```{r}
###############################################################################
########## PROGRAMS FOR ERROR CHECKING AND TRANSFERRING CENSUS DATA ########### 
###############################################################################
  
# install.packages("readr")
# install.packages("tidyverse")
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
# These lines of code download any required packages for the code to function.

# set year
year=

```


```{r}
###############################################################################
######## STEP 1 -- RUN QA/QC PROGRAMS FOR ERROR CHECKING CENSUS DATA ##########
###############################################################################

# Read in Census data 
Census <- read.csv(paste0('S:/Biogeochemistry/GCREW/5-GENX/1-Data/1-Plant biomass & CN data/Shoot Biomass Data/',year,'/Data/1-GENX SC Census (Filled).csv'))

CensusQAQC <- Census
CensusQAQC <- subset(CensusQAQC, Rep != 99)
CensusQAQC$HFlag <- ifelse(CensusQAQC$Total_Height < CensusQAQC$Green_Height, 1, 0)
CensusQAQC$HFlag <- ifelse(CensusQAQC$Total_Height > 223 | (0 < CensusQAQC$Total_Height & CensusQAQC$Total_Height < 5), 1, CensusQAQC$HFlag)
CensusQAQC$WFlag <- ifelse(CensusQAQC$Width > 6.4 | (0 < CensusQAQC$Width & CensusQAQC$Width < 0.2), 1, 0)
CensusQAQC$ZFlag <- ifelse(is.na(CensusQAQC$Total_Height) | is.na(CensusQAQC$Green_Height) | is.na(CensusQAQC$Width)| is.na(CensusQAQC$Flower_Cut), 1, 0)
CensusQAQC <- subset(CensusQAQC, HFlag != 0 | WFlag != 0 | ZFlag != 0)
# This step deletes records that have "0" in all of the flag columns, meaning there are no errors, leaving for output those records with errors
# Keep observations where any one of the flags is marked as 1

write.csv(CensusQAQC, paste0('S:/Biogeochemistry/GCREW/5-GENX/1-Data/1-Plant biomass & CN data/Shoot Biomass Data/',year,'/Data/1-CensusQAQC Error Report.csv'))

```



```{r}
###############################################################################
######## STEP 2 -- RUN QA/QC PROGRAMS FOR ERROR CHECKING DENSITY DATA #########
###############################################################################

# Read in Density data 
Density <- read.csv(paste0('S:/Biogeochemistry/GCREW/5-GENX/1-Data/1-Plant biomass & CN data/Shoot Biomass Data/',year,'/Data/2-GENX SC Density (Filled).csv')) %>%
  select(-Notes)

DensityQAQC <- Density
DensityQAQC$QDFlag <- ifelse(DensityQAQC$StemCount > 180,  1, 0)
DensityQAQC$ZFlag <- ifelse(is.na(DensityQAQC$StemCount), 1, 0)
# this step adds an NA if there are any blank cells in the rows.
DensityQAQC <- subset(DensityQAQC, QDFlag != 0 | ZFlag != 0)
# This step deletes records that have "0" in all of the flag columns, meaning there are no errors, leaving for output those records with errors or NAs.
# Keep observations where any one of the flags is marked as 1

write.csv(DensityQAQC, paste0('S:/Biogeochemistry/GCREW/5-GENX/1-Data/1-Plant biomass & CN data/Shoot Biomass Data/',year,'/Data/2-Density QAQC Error Report.csv'))

```




```{r}
###############################################################################
######## STEP 3 -- GENERATE CENSUS OUTPUT FILE FOR TRANSFER ################### 
###############################################################################

CensusTransfer <- Census[, c("Year", "Chamber", "Total_Height", "Green_Height", "Width", "Flower_Cut")]

CensusTransfer <- CensusTransfer %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(Total_Height, Green_Height, Width),
           ~ replace_na(., 0)),
    Flower_Cut = ifelse(is.na(Flower_Cut) | Flower_Cut == "", "N", Flower_Cut)
  )

write.csv(CensusTransfer, paste0('S:/Biogeochemistry/GCREW/5-GENX/1-Data/1-Plant biomass & CN data/Shoot Biomass Data/',year,'/Data/1-Census (for transfer).csv'), row.names = FALSE)
# File for transfer keeps flagged measurements in spreadsheet.

```


```{r}
###############################################################################
######## STEP 4 -- GENERATE DENSITY OUTPUT FILE FOR TRANSFER ##################
###############################################################################
  
DensityTransfer <- Density

write.csv(DensityTransfer, paste0('S:/Biogeochemistry/GCREW/5-GENX/1-Data/1-Plant biomass & CN data/Shoot Biomass Data/',year,'/Data/2-Density (for transfer).csv'), row.names = FALSE)
# File for transfer keeps flagged measurements in spreadsheet.
```
